name: PARDUS Uragano EVO gravel build
why_interesting: An exact-model build supplies unusually detailed drivetrain compatibility, while a dated independent review adds 45 mm clearance and extensive mounting evidence.
missing: Current official exact-generation product page and stock complete-bike BOM
Current mainland price and exact EVO stock state

facts.drivetrain: Custom SRAM Apex AXS controls with X1 Eagle AXS rear derailleur, 40T and 11-50
facts.brakes: SRAM Apex AXS hydraulic, flat-mount 160 mm
facts.frame: Carbon frame reported in the dated BIKETO review
facts.complete_weight_basis: BIKETO-reviewed Apex AXS/X1 Eagle AXS build without pedals
facts.mounts: Front and rear rack, fork, bottle and fender mounts

source_note: Official mainland dealer and marketplace routes are established for the family, but the current official catalog exposes Uragano RX600 and Sport rather than an EVO page. BIKETO measured the documented Apex AXS/X1 Eagle AXS review build at 9.65 kg without pedals; a separate sold-out foreign Rival XPLR size-M build was listed at about 9.0 kg. Neither value establishes a current mainland stock build. The detailed public-post component list remains a custom build, not a factory configuration.
